description: This file implements a red-black tree data structure with functions for initialization, insertion, removal, validation, and visualization. It includes support for custom key comparison functions and debugging utilities.

methods.name: __ds_tree_init
methods.description: Initializes a red-black tree with a comparison function and configuration size.

methods.name: ds_tree_node_insert
methods.description: Inserts a node with a specified key into the red-black tree, maintaining balance.

methods.name: ds_tree_node_remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the red-black tree, rebalancing as necessary.

methods.name: ds_tree_check
methods.description: Validates the integrity of the red-black tree, checking for red and black violations.

methods.name: ds_tree_graphviz
methods.description: Outputs a visual representation of the tree in Graphviz DOT format.
